cards.work: Singh, James & Rudary (2004). Predictive state representations: a new theory for modeling dynamical systems. UAI.
cards.locator: p.2-3: linear dimension = rank of the system-dynamics matrix D; Theorem 1 p.3 (nth-order Markov model has linear dimension <= (|A||O|)^n)

cards.our_equation: f15_theory.hankel / fit_linear_psr / closure_error (F15-01): D[h,t]=P(t|h), rank by SVD, linear PSR update p(Q|ho)=p(oQ|h)/p(o|h)
cards.difference: binary uncontrolled worlds with exact laws; adds a finite counterexample where a short-history block has lower rank than the true linear dimension

cards.work: Hyvarinen, Sasaki & Turner (2019). Nonlinear ICA using auxiliary variables and generalized contrastive learning. AISTATS, PMLR 89.

cards.our_equation: f15_theory.variability_rank (F15-03), contrastive_run (F15-04, fixed quadratic features, not universal)
